name: Ray Aggregation (Packet Traversal)
definition: A strategy exploiting spatial coherence where a group of rays is traced as a single unit (a packet). It is the most used strategy in current interactive systems, allows use of register SIMD to process four rays in bundle, and can be combined with frustum- and interval-arithmetic techniques.
summary: Ray aggregation groups spatially coherent rays into packets to reduce traversal overhead and enable SIMD execution, distinguishing itself from beam tracing by maintaining explicit ray representations.
